steps.description: 用低至中火把平底锅中的黄油融化。
steps.sourceDescription: Melt the butter in the pan over low to medium heat.

steps.description: 将鸡蛋磕入锅中，煎至蛋黄边缘开始凝固（蛋黄颜色变浅即为标志）。
steps.sourceDescription: Crack open the eggs into the pan and let fry until the yolks begin to harden at the edges (indicated by a lightening in the yolk color).

steps.description: 用锅铲将鸡蛋翻面：流心熟度煎 10 秒，半熟煎 30 秒，全熟最多煎 1 分钟。
steps.sourceDescription: Using the spatula, flip the eggs over and allow to cook 10 seconds for over-easy, 30 seconds for over-medium, or up to 1 minute for over-hard.

steps.description: 按口味加入盐和胡椒，然后装盘。
steps.sourceDescription: Add salt and pepper to taste, and serve.

steps.description: 把鸡蛋磕入量杯。
steps.sourceDescription: Crack eggs into a measuring cup.

steps.description: 加入牛奶（如果需要）和盐。
steps.sourceDescription: Add the milk (if desired) and salt.

steps.description: 用打蛋器或叉子打至起泡。
steps.sourceDescription: Using a whisk or fork, beat the mixture until foamy.

steps.description: 用中火在平底锅中融化黄油。
steps.sourceDescription: Melt butter in a frying pan on medium heat

steps.description: 将鸡蛋倒入平底锅。
steps.sourceDescription: Pour eggs into frying pan.

steps.description: 在鸡蛋烹煮时搅拌，将蛋块打散，让更多蛋液接触热锅。快速搅拌会形成小蛋块，较慢搅拌则形成大蛋块。
steps.sourceDescription: Stir mixture to break up the egg as it cooks and allow more liquid to touch the hot pan. Stirring rapidly will create small curds, while slower stirring will create larger curds.

steps.description: 在你觉得快熟时停止烹煮，因为鸡蛋离锅后还会继续熟化。蛋液光泽消失时即为熟了；应在这之前停止烹煮。
steps.sourceDescription: Cook until just before you feel that they are done, since the eggs will continue to cook after being removed from the pan. The eggs are done when the sheen disappears; stop cooking just before this happens.

steps.description: 盛到盘中，用黑胡椒调味（黑胡椒若在烹煮前加入会烧焦并发苦）。
steps.sourceDescription: Transfer to a plate. Season with black pepper (black pepper will burn and become bitter if seasoned before cooking).

steps.description: 可以直接吃，或配番茄酱、莎莎酱，以及／或者涂黄油的吐司。
steps.sourceDescription: Eat as is or with ketchup (tomato sauce), salsa, and/or butter on toast.

steps.description: 在不粘锅中融化黄油。加入蒜、辣椒和葱，边搅拌边炒 15 秒。
steps.sourceDescription: Melt the butter in a non-stick pan. Fry the garlic, chilli, and scallion, stirring, for 15 seconds.

steps.description: 加入鸡肉和胡萝卜，炒至鸡肉从粉红色变成白色。
steps.sourceDescription: Add the chicken and carrot. Cook until the chicken changes color from pink to white.

steps.description: 加入米饭，再加入蚝油、伍斯特酱、盐和胡椒，继续炒至充分混合。
steps.sourceDescription: Add the rice, then the oyster sauce, Worcestershire sauce, salt, and pepper. Continue to cook until well-combined.

steps.description: 趁热配上配菜食用。
steps.sourceDescription: Serve hot with the sides.

steps.description: 在鸡肉两面刷上橄榄油。两面均撒上足量粗盐、现磨黑胡椒和细磨柠檬皮屑。
steps.sourceDescription: Brush both sides of chicken with olive oil. Sprinkle both sides liberally with kosher salt, freshly ground black pepper, and finely grated lemon zest.

steps.description: 将鸡肉放入 13x9-inch 烤盘。把探针温度计插入其中一块鸡胸肉，在 400°F（200°C）的烤箱中央烘烤，直至内部温度达到 165°F（75°C）。
steps.sourceDescription: Place chicken on a 13x9-inch baking pan. Insert a probe thermometer into one of the chicken breasts and bake in the center of a 400°F (200°C) oven until internal temperature reaches 165°F (75°C).

steps.description: 移到盘中，静置 5 分钟，温热食用。
steps.sourceDescription: Remove to a plate and let rest 5 minutes. Serve warm.

steps.description: 将培根煎熟，切成小块，放在一旁备用。
steps.sourceDescription: Cook bacon strips, cut into small pieces, and set aside for later.

steps.description: 将土豆煮 5–10 分钟或煮至变软；切成小块或厚片。
steps.sourceDescription: Boil potatoes for 5–10 minutes or until softened; cut into small chunks or thick slices.

steps.description: 把土豆放入大碗，放凉至室温。
steps.sourceDescription: Place potatoes in a large bowl and let them come to room temperature.

steps.description: 在碗中混合面粉、芹菜籽、欧芹、切碎的洋葱、盐和胡椒。
steps.sourceDescription: In a bowl combine flour, celery seed, parsley, chopped onion, salt, and pepper.

steps.description: 将水和醋倒入锅中，拌入糖并煮沸。加入干料混合物，搅拌至浓稠。
steps.sourceDescription: Pour the water and vinegar into a pot, stir in sugar and bring to a boil. Add the dry mixture and stir until thickened.

steps.description: 将土豆和培根放回原来的碗，倒入煮稠的混合物。
steps.sourceDescription: In the original bowl place potatoes and bacon, pour on thickened mixture.

steps.description: 将鸡蛋弄碎，轻轻拌入碗中混合。
steps.sourceDescription: Break apart eggs and stir lightly into the bowl to combine.

steps.description: 装入大盛菜碗，撒上红椒粉。
steps.sourceDescription: Place in large serving bowl and sprinkle with paprika.

steps.description: 装盘食用。
steps.sourceDescription: Serve

steps.description: 将烤箱预热至 450°F。
steps.sourceDescription: Preheat oven to 450°F.

steps.description: 洗净土豆，可按喜好去皮，然后沿长边切成楔形块。
steps.sourceDescription: Wash, peel if you like, and cut potatoes into wedges longways.

steps.description: 放入大碗，与橄榄油拌匀。
steps.sourceDescription: Toss in large bowl with olive oil.

steps.description: 撒上百里香。
steps.sourceDescription: Sprinkle with thyme.

steps.description: 将土豆单层摆在烤盘中。
steps.sourceDescription: Place potatoes in baking pan in one layer.

steps.description: 烤 15 分钟，翻面，再烤 15 分钟。
steps.sourceDescription: Bake 15 minutes, turn, bake another 15 minutes.

steps.description: 冲洗土豆，用盐调味。
steps.sourceDescription: Rinse the potatoes and season with salt.

steps.description: 在锅中烧热油，油热后放入土豆，按需翻面，煎至各面金黄。
steps.sourceDescription: Heat the oil in a pan, and add the potatoes when hot. Cook until golden all over, flipping as needed.

steps.description: 趁热食用。
steps.sourceDescription: Serve hot.

steps.description: 将洋葱、芜菁、土豆、胡萝卜和芹菜放入水中煮，直到蔬菜熟透。
steps.sourceDescription: Boil the onion, turnip, potatoes, carrot, and celery in the water until the vegetables are cooked.

steps.description: 将面包放进碗中，把汤浇在面包上。
steps.sourceDescription: Insert the bread into a bowl. Pour the soup over it.

steps.description: 折去芦笋底部较硬的部分。
steps.sourceDescription: Snap the tough ends off the asparagus spears.

steps.description: 在中等大小的汤锅中把水煮沸，加少量盐，再加入芦笋，以较旺的小火煮 10 分钟。用夹子捞出备用，保留煮芦笋的水。
steps.sourceDescription: Bring the water to a boil in a medium saucepan, salt the water lightly, and add the asparagus spears. Cook at a lively simmer for 10 minutes.  Lift out with tongs and set aside. Reserve the cooking water.

steps.description: 另取一个足以盛下成品汤的锅，烧热黄油，加入切碎的红葱头，轻轻煮至变软但不要上色。加入煮好的芦笋和一杯煮芦笋的水，煮沸后以较旺的小火煮 5 分钟。离火，用中等网眼的筛子将汤滤入碗中，保留液体。
steps.sourceDescription: In a separate saucepan large enough to hold the finished soup, heat the butter, add the chopped shallot, and cook gently until soft but not browned. Add the cooked asparagus spears and one cup of the cooking water and bring to a boil. Cook at a lively simmer for 5 minutes. Remove from the heat and strain the soup through a medium sieve into a bowl, reserving the liquid.

steps.description: 把固体放入食物处理器，加入足量保留的液体，使其能顺畅打成泥。
steps.sourceDescription: Purée the solids in a food processor with enough of the reserved liquid to allow the mixture to purée smoothly.

steps.description: 将泥通过筛子滤回不与食物反应的锅中，用软刮刀或木勺帮助过筛，让纤维留在筛子里。丢弃筛内残渣。
steps.sourceDescription: Strain the purée through the sieve back into the non-reactive saucepan, rubbing the mixture through with a flexible scraper or wooden spoon and leaving the fibrous parts in the sieve. Discard the contents of the sieve.

steps.description: 加入奶油及足量剩余的芦笋水，调至所需浓度。按口味用盐、现磨黑胡椒和卡宴辣椒粉调味。小火温和加热，不要让汤沸腾。
steps.sourceDescription: Add the cream and enough of the remaining asparagus cooking water to give the soup the consistency you want. Season to taste with salt, freshly ground black pepper, and cayenne pepper. Reheat gently over low heat, making sure not to let the soup boil.

steps.description: 可趁热或冷藏后食用。若要冷食，先放凉，再不加盖冷藏至彻底冷透，然后盖上保鲜膜。可冷藏保存最多 2 天。
steps.sourceDescription: Serve hot or chilled. If you want to serve it chilled, let it cool, then refrigerate it uncovered until thoroughly cold, then cover with plastic wrap. You can keep it refrigerated for up to 2 days.

steps.description: 将一锅水煮沸。
steps.sourceDescription: Bring a pot of water to a boil.

steps.description: 把意大利面和胡萝卜加入沸水，煮 4 分钟。
steps.sourceDescription: Add spaghetti and carrots to the boiling water, and cook for 4 minutes.

steps.description: 加入四季豆，再煮 4 分钟。
steps.sourceDescription: Add green beans, and cook for another 4 minutes.

steps.description: 同时加热番茄酱。
steps.sourceDescription: Meanwhile, heat the tomato sauce.

steps.description: 沥干意大利面和蔬菜，与加热好的酱拌匀。
steps.sourceDescription: Drain the spaghetti and the vegetables, then mix it with the heated sauce.

steps.description: 如有需要，加一小撮盐。
steps.sourceDescription: Add a pinch of salt if needed.

steps.description: 装盘食用。
steps.sourceDescription: Serve.

steps.description: 将洋葱切得很细，煮约 4 分钟。
steps.sourceDescription: Chop the onions really fine. Boil them for about 4 minutes.

steps.description: 煮洋葱时，将番茄切成四瓣，去掉多汁的中心部分。中心部分可用来做番茄汤，也可丢弃。
steps.sourceDescription: While they are boiling, cut the tomatoes in quarters, and remove the juicy centre. You can use the centres for tomato soup or throw them away.

steps.description: 把番茄切成与洋葱一样细的小丁。
steps.sourceDescription: Dice tomatoes just as finely as the onion.

steps.description: 将蒜去皮并切碎。
steps.sourceDescription: Peel and mince the garlic.

steps.description: 洋葱煮好后，放入筛子或类似容器，沥去水分。
steps.sourceDescription: When the onions are done boiling, put them in a sieve or something comparable to drain the water.

steps.description: 洋葱、番茄和蒜都切细后，一起放入碗中摇匀或搅拌。
steps.sourceDescription: Once onions, tomatoes and garlic are all finely chopped, put all of them in a bowl, and shake/stir.

steps.description: 加入少量橄榄油，并按口味用盐和胡椒调味。
steps.sourceDescription: Add a bit of olive oil and salt and pepper to taste.

steps.description: 混合食材，倒入 9-inch（20 cm）烤盘。也可以直接在烤盘中小心混合。
steps.sourceDescription: Mix the ingredients and pour them into a 9-inch (20 cm) baking pan. They can also be carefully mixed in the pan.
Bake at 350 °F (175 °C) for 40–45 minutes.

steps.description: 可以热食或冷食，也可以加牛奶或不加牛奶。
steps.sourceDescription: Serve hot, cold, with or without milk.

steps.description: 将面包片烤成吐司，抹上黄油。
steps.sourceDescription: Toast and butter the bread slices.

steps.description: 混合花生酱、蜂蜜和黄油，涂在一片吐司上。
steps.sourceDescription: Combine the peanut butter, honey, and butter. Spread over one slice of toasted bread.

steps.description: 在另一片吐司上涂上果酱。
steps.sourceDescription: Spread preserves (jam) over the other slice.

steps.description: 将两片合拢成三明治。
steps.sourceDescription: Put both halves of sandwich together.

steps.description: 对半切开，配牛奶食用。
steps.sourceDescription: Cut in half and serve with milk

steps.description: 准备蒸锅，将水煮沸。
steps.sourceDescription: Prepare steamer and bring water to a boil.

steps.description: 将芦笋截成两半，丢弃较粗的底端，或用于堆肥。
steps.sourceDescription: Trim asparagus spears in half, discarding (or composting) the thicker ends.

steps.description: 蒸芦笋 8–10 分钟，至软嫩但仍脆。
steps.sourceDescription: Steam the asparagus for 8–10 minutes, until tender, but still crisp.

steps.description: 用中火加热小煎锅，加入芝麻，摇动或搅拌。当芝麻刚开始变深色并散发烘烤香味时就好了。不要无人看管，芝麻容易烧焦。
steps.sourceDescription: Heat a small skillet or frying pan on medium heat. Add the sesame seeds and shake or stir. They are done when they just begin to darken and give off a pleasant toasted aroma. Be careful not to leave unattended as they can easily burn.

steps.description: 将芦笋从蒸锅取出，抖去水分，摆在盘中。
steps.sourceDescription: Remove asparagus from steamer, shake to drain water, and arrange on serving plate.

steps.description: 在芦笋上淋上酱油和芝麻油。
steps.sourceDescription: Drizzle the soy sauce and the sesame oil over the asparagus.

steps.description: 撒上芝麻，再撒极少量粗盐。
steps.sourceDescription: Sprinkle with the sesame seeds, and give a very light sprinkle with the Kosher salt.

steps.description: 将土豆放入水中煮熟。
steps.sourceDescription: Boil potatoes in water until done.

steps.description: 沥干土豆并压成泥。
steps.sourceDescription: Drain the potatoes and mash them.

steps.description: 将牛奶倒入锅中，加入切碎的葱，旺火煮。
steps.sourceDescription: Pour the milk into a saucepan, add the chopped scallions and cook vigorously.

steps.description: 煮好后滤出葱，牛奶放在一旁备用。
steps.sourceDescription: When cooked, sieve the scallions and set the milk aside.

steps.description: 将葱加入土豆泥，拌匀。
steps.sourceDescription: Add the scallions to the potatoes and mix well.

steps.description: 尽量加入足量带有葱香的牛奶，使混合物柔软湿润。
steps.sourceDescription: Add as much of the scallion-infused milk as possible to make a ‘wet’ soft mixture.

steps.description: 用现磨胡椒和盐调味。
steps.sourceDescription: Season with freshly ground pepper and salt.

steps.description: 食用时在中央挖出凹槽，注入融化的黄油。
steps.sourceDescription: Serve with a central well filled with melted butter.

steps.description: 将包菜煮至软嫩，沥干。
steps.sourceDescription: Boil the cabbage until tender. Drain.

steps.description: 用黄油炒切碎的培根。
steps.sourceDescription: Fry the chopped bacon in butter.

steps.description: 混合熟包菜、培根、欧芹、鸡蛋、芝士、卡宴辣椒粉和切碎的洋葱，按口味用盐调味。
steps.sourceDescription: Combine the cooked cabbage, bacon, parsley, egg, cheese, cayenne, and chopped onion. Season to taste with salt.

steps.description: 将混合物移入玻璃烤盘，烤 15 分钟，温度为 180˚C。
steps.sourceDescription: Transfer mixture to a glass baking dish. Bake 15 minutes at 180˚C.

steps.description: 配烤面包食用。
steps.sourceDescription: Serve with toasted bread.

steps.description: 把南瓜洗干净，注意清除粪肥、泥土等。切去瓜蒂。
steps.sourceDescription: Clean your pumpkin well, being careful to remove manure, dirt, etc. Chop off the stem.

steps.description: 将洗净的南瓜放入 375 °F（190 C）的烤箱，烘烤约 45 分钟（每 250 g 所需时间）。小于 500 g 的小南瓜效果最好。
steps.sourceDescription: Bake the cleaned pumpkin in a 375 °F (190 C) oven for about 45 minutes per 250 g. A small pumpkin of less than 500 g works best.

steps.description: 取出南瓜，静置 5–10 分钟。
steps.sourceDescription: Remove pumpkin and allow to rest for 5–10 minutes.

steps.description: 与此同时，准备海盐、黄油和胡椒研磨器。
steps.sourceDescription: During this time, take out sea salt, butter, and your pepper mill.

steps.description: 用斩骨刀、肉刀或厨房小斧将南瓜切成两半。
steps.sourceDescription: Chop pumpkin in half with cleaver, butcher knife, or kitchen hatchet.

steps.description: 去掉籽和内部纤维；籽可烤制，其余丢弃。
steps.sourceDescription: Remove seeds and guts; roast seeds and discard the rest.

steps.description: 将瓜皮与瓜肉分开。
steps.sourceDescription: Separate the skin from the flesh.

steps.description: 把热南瓜肉放入食物处理器，按口味加入盐、胡椒和黄油。
steps.sourceDescription: Place hot pumpkin flesh in a food processor, along with salt, pepper, and butter to taste.

steps.description: 将豌豆放入相当于其体积 2–3 倍的水中，加入小苏打以加快浸泡。
steps.sourceDescription: Place the peas in 2–3 times their volume of water, along with the baking soda, which speeds the soaking process.

steps.description: 浸泡过夜。
steps.sourceDescription: Leave to soak overnight.

steps.description: 第二天沥干豌豆，放入锅中，加水至刚好盖住豌豆。
steps.sourceDescription: The next day, drain the peas, and place in a saucepan with enough water to just cover them.

steps.description: 加入糖。
steps.sourceDescription: Add the sugar.

steps.description: 煮沸后小火煮约 20 分钟，不时搅拌，帮助豌豆碎开。
steps.sourceDescription: Bring to the boil and simmer for about 20 minutes, stirring occasionally to help break up the peas.

steps.description: 加水或收汁，调至所需浓度。
steps.sourceDescription: Add water or reduce to the desired consistency.

steps.description: 按口味用盐和胡椒调味。
steps.sourceDescription: Season to taste with salt and pepper.

steps.description: 将包菜切成细丝（约 1–2 mm 厚）。
steps.sourceDescription: Slice the cabbage finely (about 1–2 mm thick).

steps.description: 用油、醋、盐和胡椒调成沙拉汁，与包菜拌匀。
steps.sourceDescription: Make a dressing of oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper. Toss the cabbage with the dressing.

steps.description: 将沙拉放进冰箱过夜。
steps.sourceDescription: Put the salad in the fridge overnight.

steps.description: 混合醋、油、盐和糖，做成腌汁。
steps.sourceDescription: Mix vinegar, oil, salt and sugar for the marinade.

steps.description: 切去黄瓜两端，去皮并切片。
steps.sourceDescription: Trim the ends from the cucumbers, peel them, and slice them.

steps.description: 将洋葱去皮，尽量切成薄片。
steps.sourceDescription: Peel the onion and slice it as thinly as possible.

steps.description: 将腌汁倒在黄瓜和洋葱上，拌匀。
steps.sourceDescription: Pour the marinade over the cucumbers and onions and mix well.

steps.description: 放在阴凉处或冰箱中至少两小时，期间不时搅拌。
steps.sourceDescription: Let it sit in a cool place or refrigerator for at least two hours, stirring occasionally.

steps.description: 连同腌汁盛在碗中，用沙拉夹或漏勺取用。
steps.sourceDescription: Serve in a bowl, marinade and all, using salad tongs or a slotted spoon to dish out servings.

steps.description: 切去番茄顶部。
steps.sourceDescription: Cut tops from tomatoes.

steps.description: 挖出果肉，保持外壳完整。
steps.sourceDescription: Scoop out pulp, leaving shells intact.

steps.description: 将番茄果肉切碎。
steps.sourceDescription: Chop tomato pulp.

steps.description: 沥干番茄外壳，在内部撒上盐和胡椒。
steps.sourceDescription: Drain tomato shells and sprinkle cavities with salt and pepper.

steps.description: 混合番茄果肉、培根、芹菜、鸡蛋、蛋黄酱、欧芹，以及量好的盐和胡椒。
steps.sourceDescription: Combine tomato pulp, bacon, celery, eggs, mayonnaise, parsley, and measured salt and pepper.

steps.description: 充分搅拌。
steps.sourceDescription: Stir well.

steps.description: 将培根鸡蛋混合物填入番茄壳。
steps.sourceDescription: Fill tomato shell with bacon and egg mixture.

steps.description: 撒上红椒粉。
steps.sourceDescription: Sprinkle with paprika.

steps.description: 将鸡蛋和黄油放入咖啡杯。
steps.sourceDescription: Crack the eggs and butter in a coffee cup.

steps.description: 用微波炉高功率加热 30 秒。
steps.sourceDescription: Microwave on high power for 30 seconds.

steps.description: 从微波炉取出，搅拌，再放回。
steps.sourceDescription: Remove from the microwave, stir, and replace.

steps.description: 再用高功率加热 30 秒。
steps.sourceDescription: Cook for another 30 seconds on high.

steps.description: 打散鸡蛋。拌入面粉并揉成很硬的面团。
steps.sourceDescription: Beat the egg. Mix and knead in flour until you have a very stiff dough.

steps.description: 将面团擀成薄片。
steps.sourceDescription: Roll the dough out into a thin sheet.

steps.description: 撒上足量面粉防粘，再紧紧卷成条状。
steps.sourceDescription: Sprinkle the dough with a good amount of flour to prevent it from sticking to itself. Tightly roll up the dough to make a log.

steps.description: 用锋利的刀横切成薄片，类似切包菜沙拉的做法。展开面条，并拌上面粉。
steps.sourceDescription: Use a sharp knife to cut the log cross-wise into thin slices, similar to how you would slice cabbage for slaw. Unroll the noodles and toss with flour.

steps.description: 把面条加入沸腾的汤中，小火煮 10 分钟。
steps.sourceDescription: Add the noodles to boiling soup. Simmer for 10 minutes.

steps.description: 在碗中混合水、燕麦片和盐。
steps.sourceDescription: Mix water, oat flakes, and salt in a bowl.

steps.description: 高火煮 2–3 分钟。
steps.sourceDescription: Boil on high heat for 2–3 minutes.

steps.description:
搅拌后立即食用。

sv:Gröt i mikrovågsugnen
steps.sourceDescription:
Stir and serve immediately.

sv:Gröt i mikrovågsugnen

steps.description: 混合除番茄外的所有食材，做成馅料。
steps.sourceDescription: Combine all ingredients except tomatoes to make the filling.

steps.description: 将馅料装入 gallon-size 密封袋，在底部一角剪出小孔。
steps.sourceDescription: Place filling into a gallon-size zip-top bag with a small hole snipped in one of the bottom corners.

steps.description: 将番茄填至约 ¾ 满。
steps.sourceDescription: Fill tomatoes about ¾ full.

steps.description: 冷藏后作为开胃菜食用。
steps.sourceDescription: Serve chilled as an appetizer.

steps.description: 将一锅水煮沸。加入意面，煮约 10 分钟（或至意面变软）。
steps.sourceDescription: Bring a pot of water to the boil. Add the pasta and cook for about 10 minutes (or until the pasta is soft).

steps.description: 沥干意面，让锅中没有残留水分，再将意面放回锅中。
steps.sourceDescription: Drain the pasta so that no water remains in the pan. Return drained pasta to the pot.

steps.description: 将奶油、芝士、鸡肉和海鲜酱加入意面。
steps.sourceDescription: Add the cream, cheeses, chicken, and hoisin sauce to the pasta.

steps.description: 煮几分钟，使所有食材热透。
steps.sourceDescription: Cook for a few minutes to warm everything through.

steps.description: 装盘食用。
steps.sourceDescription: Serve.

steps.description: 将香蕉、冰淇淋、糖和牛奶按需搅打至顺滑绵密。
steps.sourceDescription: Blend the banana, ice cream, sugar, and milk as desired until smooth and creamy.

steps.description: 如有需要，加一小撮肉桂。
steps.sourceDescription: If desired, add a pinch of cinnamon.

steps.description: 在小锅中加热油。
steps.sourceDescription: Heat oil in a small pot.

steps.description: 加入葱，边经常搅拌边煮几分钟。
steps.sourceDescription: Add green onion. Cook for a few minutes while stirring frequently.

steps.description: 加入 2 ½ cups 水，煮沸。
steps.sourceDescription: Add 2 ½ cups of water. Bring to a boil.

steps.description: 把味噌溶于剩余的 ½ cup 水中，再加入锅内。
steps.sourceDescription: Dissolve miso in remaining ½ cup of water and add to pot.

steps.description: 调小火；如需要，加入蘑菇、海藻和豆腐。
steps.sourceDescription: Lower heat and add mushrooms, seaweed, and tofu, if desired.

steps.description: 把玉米和水放入大锅，煮沸。
steps.sourceDescription: Combine the corn and water in a large pot. Bring to a boil.

steps.description: 用黄油和面粉制作油面糊。
steps.sourceDescription: Make a roux with the butter and flour.

steps.description: 玉米变软后，把油面糊加入汤中。
steps.sourceDescription: Add the roux to the soup when the corn is tender.

steps.description: 再煮沸 10–15 分钟。
steps.sourceDescription: Boil for an additional 10–15 minutes.

steps.description: 打散鸡蛋并加入汤中，立即把汤移离热源。
steps.sourceDescription: Beat the egg and add it to the soup. Immediately take the soup off the heat.

steps.description: 按口味加入盐和胡椒。
steps.sourceDescription: Add salt and pepper to taste.

steps.description: 用搅拌机把豆腐和 ¼ cup 水搅打约 2 分钟，或直到顺滑。
steps.sourceDescription: In a blender, blend tofu and ¼ cup water for about 2 minutes, or until smooth

steps.description: 加入剩余的 ¾ cup 水，搅打至混合均匀。
steps.sourceDescription: Add remaining ¾ cup water and process until blended.

steps.description: 在大平底锅中炒洋葱约 5 分钟。
steps.sourceDescription: In a large skillet, sauté onion for about 5 minutes.

steps.description: 加入蘑菇和百里香，再炒 5 分钟。
steps.sourceDescription: Add mushrooms and thyme, and sauté 5 minutes more.

steps.description: 加入葡萄酒，小火煮 5 分钟。
steps.sourceDescription: Add wine and simmer for 5 minutes.

steps.description: 加入豆腐混合物，小火煮至蘑菇变软。
steps.sourceDescription: Add tofu mixture and simmer until mushrooms are wilted.

steps.description: 拌入酱油，按口味调整盐量。
steps.sourceDescription: Stir in soy sauce, and adjust salt to taste.

steps.description: 在厚底汤锅或锅中加热黄油，加入切碎的洋葱和蘑菇，搅拌几秒至刚变透明。不要让蘑菇变褐。
steps.sourceDescription: Heat the butter in a heavy sauce pot or pan, add chopped onion and mushroom, and stir for few seconds until just transparent. Don't let the mushroom brown.

steps.description: 加入面粉，搅拌制成油面糊。不要让它变褐。
steps.sourceDescription: Add flour, and stir to make roux. Don't let it brown.

steps.description: 逐渐用打蛋器拌入牛奶或高汤，煮沸。
steps.sourceDescription: Gradually whisk in the milk or stock, and bring to boil.

steps.description: 小火煮汤 10 至 15 分钟，直到蘑菇熟透。
steps.sourceDescription: Simmer the soup for 10 to 15 minutes until mushroom is cooked.

steps.description: 用食物研磨器处理汤，或用搅拌机将它打成泥。
steps.sourceDescription: Pass the soup through a food mill or use a blender to purée it.

steps.description: 把蘑菇泥加入汤中，再加入足量热牛奶或奶油，使汤达到适当浓稠度。不要煮沸。
steps.sourceDescription: Add the purée of mushroom into the soup, then add enough hot milk or cream to the soup to bring it to proper consistency. Do not boil.

steps.description: 按口味调味，用切成细小方丁的蘑菇和欧芹装饰。
steps.sourceDescription: Season to taste, and garnish with brunoised mushroom and parsley.

steps.description: 用中火加热平底锅，融化黄油。
steps.sourceDescription: Heat a skillet or frying pan over medium heat and melt the butter.

steps.description: 把香蕉片加入锅中，并撒上红糖。
steps.sourceDescription: Add the banana slices to the pan and sprinkle them with brown sugar.

steps.description: 每面煎香蕉 2–3 分钟，或至金黄并焦糖化。
steps.sourceDescription: Cook the bananas for 2–3 minutes on each side or until they turn golden brown and caramelized.

steps.description: 如需要，可在煎制时给香蕉撒上肉桂。
steps.sourceDescription: If desired, sprinkle cinnamon over the bananas during cooking.

steps.description: 从锅中取出煎香蕉，趁热食用。也可搭配一勺香草冰淇淋。
steps.sourceDescription: Remove the fried bananas from the pan and serve them hot. Optionally, serve with a scoop of vanilla ice cream for an extra treat.

steps.description: 按包装说明煮意面，沥干。
steps.sourceDescription: Cook the pasta as directed on the packaging. Drain.

steps.description: 在搅拌碗中混合鸡蛋、牛奶、盐和胡椒。
steps.sourceDescription: Combine the eggs, milk, salt, and pepper in a mixing bowl.

steps.description: 拌入擦碎的芝士。
steps.sourceDescription: Mix in the grated cheese.

steps.description: 融化黄油并加入混合物。
steps.sourceDescription: Melt the butter and add to the mixture.

steps.description: 煮沸少量水，加入高汤，然后拌入混合物。
steps.sourceDescription: Boil a small amount of water and add the stock, then stir it into the mixture.

steps.description: 拌入擦碎的西葫芦，再拌入沥干的意面。
steps.sourceDescription: Stir in the grated zucchini, then the drained pasta.

steps.description: 给烤盘或焗烤容器抹油，把碗中的原料均匀铺入。
steps.sourceDescription: Grease a baking or casserole dish, and spread the ingredients from the bowl evenly in it.

steps.description: 以 200°C（400°F）烤约 30 分钟，或直到焗意面内部也完全凝固。
steps.sourceDescription: Bake at 200°C (400°F) for about 30 minutes, or until the pasta bake is firm all the way through.

steps.description: 用少量牛奶把玉米淀粉调成顺滑的糊。
steps.sourceDescription: Mix the cornstarch smoothly with a little milk to form a paste.

steps.description: 把剩余牛奶和糖放入锅中。煮沸后加入玉米淀粉糊，再煮沸约 10 分钟。
steps.sourceDescription: Put the remaining milk into a pan with the sugar. When boiling add the cornstarch paste, and boil for about 10 minutes.

steps.description: 让混合物稍凉，再加入打散的蛋黄，搅拌至变稠。
steps.sourceDescription: Let the mixture cool a little, then add the beaten egg yolks, and stir until they thicken.

steps.description: 加入香草和香蕉。冷却后，倒入准备好的模具。
steps.sourceDescription: Add the vanilla, the bananas. When cool, pour into the prepared mould.

steps.description: 冷藏几小时，使其凝固。
steps.sourceDescription: Chill for a few hours to set.

steps.description: 把玉米以外的全部原料放入小碗，混合均匀。
steps.sourceDescription: Combine all ingredients except corn in small bowl. Mix well.

steps.description: 每根玉米取约 1 tablespoon 混合物涂抹在表面。
steps.sourceDescription: Measure about 1 tablespoon of the mixture and spread over each ear of corn.

steps.description: 用厚铝箔包住每根玉米。
steps.sourceDescription: Wrap each ear of corn in heavy foil.

steps.description: 用中火烧烤 10–15 分钟，或直到变软。
steps.sourceDescription: Grill over medium heat 10–15 minutes, or until tender.

steps.description: 把西葫芦切成中等大小的方块。
steps.sourceDescription: Chop the zucchinis into medium-sized squares

steps.description: 把西葫芦放入碗中，轻轻加入橄榄油、调味盐、蒜粉（可选）和洋葱粉（可选）。
steps.sourceDescription: Put zucchini into a bowl and lightly add olive oil, season salt, garlic powder (optional), and onion powder (optional)

steps.description: 用空气炸锅烹饪 8 分钟，温度为 400 F，或直到变脆。
steps.sourceDescription: Cook in air fryer for 8 minutes at 400 F or until crispy.

steps.description: 按口味用盐、黑胡椒和红辣椒给三文鱼调味。
steps.sourceDescription: Season salmon with salt, black pepper, and red pepper to taste.

steps.description: 在铝箔上喷或抹食用油，并把铝箔放在饼干烤盘或烤盘内。
steps.sourceDescription: Spray or rub in cooking oil on aluminum foil and place on cookie sheet or in baking pan.

steps.description: 挤上柠檬汁，并在每块三文鱼上放一茶匙黄油。
steps.sourceDescription: Squeeze lemon juice and place a teaspoon of butter on each salmon steak.
Bake at 400°F / 200°C for 19 mins.

steps.description: 把烤箱预热至 180°C（350°F）。
steps.sourceDescription: Pre-heat the oven to 180°C (350°F)

steps.description: 剥香蕉皮，在碗中压碎，不要压得太细。
steps.sourceDescription: Peel the bananas and squash them not too finely in a bowl.

steps.description: 拌入燕麦。
steps.sourceDescription: Incorporate the oatmeal.

steps.description: 拌入肉桂粉和/或蜂蜜（可选）。
steps.sourceDescription: Incorporate cinnamon powder and/or honey (optional).

steps.description: 在烤盘上铺烘焙纸，把混合物做成圆饼，每个约 8 cm（3 in）。
steps.sourceDescription: On the oven tray, place parchment paper and form discs of the mix, each around 8 cm (3 in)

steps.description: 用热风循环烤约 20 分钟，直到表面金黄、略脆。
steps.sourceDescription: Cook with rotating heat for around 20 minutes, until outside becomes golden and slightly crispy.

steps.description: 可温热或冷却后食用。密封容器中可保存几天。
steps.sourceDescription: Eat warm or cold. Can be kept a couple of days in a sealed container.

steps.description: 在大搅拌碗中混合面粉、糖、泡打粉和少量盐。
steps.sourceDescription: Combine flour, sugar, baking powder and a little bit of salt in a large mixing bowl.

steps.description: 把牛奶和鸡蛋搅入面粉混合物，直到面糊中没有结块。
steps.sourceDescription: Whisk milk and egg into the flour mixture until no clumps remain in the resulting batter.

steps.description: 加入压碎的香蕉，混合均匀。
steps.sourceDescription: Add mashed bananas and mix well.

steps.description: 在温热的平底锅中加入一些黄油。
steps.sourceDescription: Add some butter to a medium warm frying pan.

steps.description:
按喜好做小或大的煎饼。等表面出现小气泡（2 至 5 分钟），翻面并继续煎至底部变褐。重复操作。

可以随煎随吃，也可以把盘子放在预热的烤箱里（低温），让做好的煎饼保持温热。
steps.sourceDescription:
Make smaller or bigger pancakes, up to you. Wait until tiny air bubbles form on top (2 to 5 minutes), turn and continue frying until the bottom is browned. Repeat.

Either eat the pancakes as they get ready or put a plate in a preheated oven (low degree) to keep the ready pancakes warm.

steps.description: 加热油，加入牛肉，炒至变褐，把肉推到锅边。
steps.sourceDescription: Heat oil, add beef and stir-fry until meat is browned and push to sides of pan.

steps.description: 加入西兰花和胡萝卜，盖上锅盖，把蔬菜蒸至仅略有脆感。
steps.sourceDescription: Add broccoli and carrots. Cover and steam vegetables until they are only slightly crunchy.

steps.description: 把蔬菜盛入碗中，在肉中加入牛肉汤、盐和胡椒。
steps.sourceDescription: Remove vegetables to a bowl. Add bouillon, salt and pepper to meat.

steps.description: 混合玉米淀粉、2 Tbsp 水和酱油，加入肉中使酱汁变稠。
steps.sourceDescription: Combine corn starch, 2 Tbsp water, and soy sauce. Add to meat to thicken sauce.

steps.description: 把蔬菜加回并加热，配米饭食用。
steps.sourceDescription: Add vegetables and heat. Serve over rice.

steps.description: 在炖锅或汤锅中煎培根，取出切碎，稍后再加回。
steps.sourceDescription: Cook bacon in stew or soup pot, remove bacon to chop up and add back in later.

steps.description: 加入黄油，烹煮洋葱和蒜；按喜好调味。
steps.sourceDescription: Add butter and cook onions and garlic: Season as desired.

steps.description: 加入面粉并炒熟。
steps.sourceDescription: Add and cook flour.

steps.description: 拌入高汤，再拌入 half and half（半奶半奶油）。
steps.sourceDescription: Stir in broth, then stir in half and half.

steps.description: 加入日式高汤或蛤蜊汁，轻轻煮沸，再小火煮 20 分钟。
steps.sourceDescription: Add dashi or clam juice, bring to gentle boil and simmer for 20 minutes.

steps.description: 加入土豆，小火煮至熟，通常约需 25 分钟。
steps.sourceDescription: Add potatoes and simmer till cooked, usually around 25 minutes.

steps.description: 加入蛤蜊，煮约 5 分钟。
steps.sourceDescription: Add clams, cook for about 5 minutes.

steps.description: 装饰后即可食用。
steps.sourceDescription: Garnish and ready to serve.

steps.description: 清洗、处理全部蔬菜，并切丁。
steps.sourceDescription: Wash, clean, and dice all vegetables.

steps.description: 去掉三文鱼片上的鳞，也可按喜好完全去皮。切丁。
steps.sourceDescription: Remove scales from salmon fillet or remove skin entirely, up to you. Dice.

steps.description: 在锅中融化黄油。加入切丁的韭葱，用中大火炒约 5 分钟，至韭葱稍软。
steps.sourceDescription: In a pot, melt butter. Add diced leeks and cook on medium-high about 5 minutes until the leeks wilt a bit.

steps.description: 加入水（或高汤）和其他蔬菜。煮沸后，用中火煮约 10-15 分钟，直到土豆熟。
steps.sourceDescription: Add water (or stock) and other vegetables. Bring to a boil and cook on medium heat about 10-15 minutes until the potatoes are ready.

steps.description: 加入切丁的三文鱼和重奶油，再煮 5-10 分钟使三文鱼熟透。
steps.sourceDescription: Add diced salmon fillet and heavy cream. Cook for additional 5-10 minutes to cook the salmon.

steps.description: 最后按口味加入盐和胡椒，配莳萝装饰后食用。
steps.sourceDescription: Add salt and pepper to taste at the end. Serve with dill as garnish.

steps.description: 把四季豆煮 10 分钟。
steps.sourceDescription: Boil green beans for 10 minutes

steps.description: 切洋葱、番茄、蒜和鱼。
steps.sourceDescription: Cut onions, tomato, garlic and fish.

steps.description: 在炒锅中加热油，炒洋葱和蒜。
steps.sourceDescription: Heat oil on a wok and sauté the onion and garlic

steps.description: 加入四季豆、番茄、高汤和香料，煮沸 6 分钟。
steps.sourceDescription: Add beans, tomato, broth and spices and boil for 6 minutes

steps.description: 加入椰奶、鱼和整只椒，再煮沸 6 分钟。
steps.sourceDescription: Add coconut milk, fish and pepper (whole) and boil for an additional 6 minutes.

steps.description: 把西兰花切成小花（倒拿西兰花，用小刀沿着茎周围切）。
steps.sourceDescription: Cut broccoli into little flourettes (hold the broccoli upside down and cut around the stem with a pairing knife)

steps.description: 给平底锅或炒锅加约半英寸（1.57cm）深的水，大火煮沸。
steps.sourceDescription: Fill your pan (or wok) around half inch (1.57cm) with water and bring to a rapid boil.

steps.description: 加入西兰花，盖上盖子蒸约 3 分钟。
steps.sourceDescription: Put broccoli in and steam with lid on for approx. 3 minutes.

steps.description: 沥干西兰花，把锅擦干。
steps.sourceDescription: Drain broccoli and wipe pan dry.

steps.description: 加入一茶匙油，炒蒜和姜（芝麻油可带来亚洲风味，中性油或橄榄油也可以）。
steps.sourceDescription: One teaspoon of oil and saute garlic and ginger (use sesame seed oil for Asian touch, but neutral or olive oil works well too).

steps.description: 用雪利酒刮起锅底，再放入半杯（约 120 ml）温水或鸡汤，用中大火收汁。
steps.sourceDescription: Deglaze with sherry, put half a cup (approx 120 ml) of warm water or chicken stock. Reduce on medium-high heat.

steps.description: 按口味拌入酱油、红糖和柠檬汁。
steps.sourceDescription: Stir in soy sauce, brown sugar and lemon juice to your taste.

steps.description: 用玉米淀粉把酱汁调稠。
steps.sourceDescription: Thicken sauce with corn starch.

steps.description: 把沥干的熟西兰花加回，短时间翻炒，保留爽脆口感。
steps.sourceDescription: Put dry cooked broccoli back in and saute for very short time (you want it nice and crunchy).

steps.description: 把黄油放入平底锅，用中火加热。
steps.sourceDescription: Place the butter in a frying pan and place over medium heat.

steps.description: 加入全部切碎的洋葱，混合均匀，烹煮 10 分钟，直到洋葱稍呈半透明的金黄色。
steps.sourceDescription: Add all the chopped onions, mix well and leave for 10 minutes until the onions turn a little translucent golden.

steps.description: 加入切细的口蘑，混合均匀，加入盐。盖上盖子煮 5 分钟。
steps.sourceDescription: Add finely chopped champignons, mix well and add salt. Close the lid for 5 minutes.

steps.description: 加入一汤匙面粉，搅拌。
steps.sourceDescription: Add a tablespoon of flour, stir.

steps.description: 3 分钟后，加入一杯奶油（或牛奶），混合均匀，盖上盖子煮 10 分钟。
steps.sourceDescription: After 3 minutes, add a glass of cream (or milk), mix well and close the lid for 10 minutes.

steps.description: 加入盐和胡椒，混合均匀。
steps.sourceDescription: Add salt, pepper and mix.

steps.description: 把一大锅盐水煮沸，把意面煮至 al dente（有嚼劲）。
steps.sourceDescription: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook pasta al dente

steps.description: 在杯中混合面粉、芥末、烟熏红椒粉、盐和胡椒。加入蔬菜高汤，搅拌至没有结块。
steps.sourceDescription: In a cup, combine flour, mustard, smoked paprika, salt and pepper. Add broth and whisk until no lumps remain.

steps.description: 煮意面时，在中号煎锅中用中火融化黄油。
steps.sourceDescription: While pasta is cooking, melt butter in a medium skillet and over medium heat.

steps.description: 黄油融化后，加入洋葱，炒软。
steps.sourceDescription: When the butter is melted, add onions and cook until softened.

steps.description: 加入蘑菇，炒至水分全部蒸发、蘑菇略褐，约需 7 分钟。
steps.sourceDescription: Add mushrooms and cook until all water evaporates and mushrooms are slightly browned, about 7 minutes.

steps.description: 加入蒜，再炒 30 秒。
steps.sourceDescription: Add garlic and cook for another 30 seconds.

steps.description: 把面粉与高汤的混合物倒入蘑菇中，煮至变稠，约需 2 分钟。
steps.sourceDescription: Pour the flour and broth mixture into the mushrooms and cook until thickens, about 2 minutes.

steps.description: 拌入 crème fraîche（法式酸奶油）。
steps.sourceDescription: Stir in Creme Fraiche.

steps.description: 把沥干的意面加入蘑菇酱中，充分拌匀，让面条裹上酱汁。
steps.sourceDescription: Add the strained pasta to the mushroom sauce and stir to coat the pasta completely.

steps.description: 立即食用。
steps.sourceDescription: Serve immediately.

steps.description: 在中号碗中混合面粉、糖、肉桂、泡打粉和 1 pinch 盐。
steps.sourceDescription: In a medium bowl, combine flour, sugar, cinnamon, baking powder, and 1 pinch of salt.

steps.description: 分开蛋黄和蛋白，把蛋黄加入干料中。
steps.sourceDescription: Separate the egg yolk and egg white. Add the egg yolk to the dry ingredients.

steps.description: 把蛋白打至起泡。
steps.sourceDescription: Whisk the egg white until foamy.

steps.description: 把去皮的苹果切成细条，也可以擦碎。
steps.sourceDescription: Slice the peeled apple into thin strips. Alternatively, grate the apple.

steps.description: 把干料、苹果、香草精、蛋白和牛奶混合成均匀面糊。
steps.sourceDescription: Combine dry ingredients, apple, vanilla extract, egg white, and milk into a homogenous batter.

steps.description: 在大平底锅中加入 1 tbsp 黄油。加入面糊（每个煎饼约 3 tbsp），用中大火每面煎 2 分钟。
steps.sourceDescription: To a large pan, add 1 tbsp butter. Add the batter (about 3 tbsp per pancake) and cook for 2 min per side on medium-high heat.

steps.description: 把预煮面条放入一碗热水中浸泡 2-3 分钟，使其松散，再沥干备用。
steps.sourceDescription: Loosen the precooked noodles by soaking in a bowl of hot water for 2-3 minutes, then drain and set aside.

steps.description: 在碗中混合酱油、蚝油、芝麻油和 2 Tbsp 水。
steps.sourceDescription: Mix together the soy sauce, oyster sauce, sesame oil and 2 Tbsp water in a bowl.

steps.description: 用大火加热炒锅或大平底锅，加入油，把胡萝卜和西兰花炒 2 分钟。
steps.sourceDescription: Heat a wok or large frying pan over a high heat, add the oil and stir-fry the carrot and broccoli for 2 minutes.

steps.description: 加入豆腐，再炒 4 分钟。
steps.sourceDescription: Add the tofu and stir-fry for 4 minutes.

steps.description: 加入蒜和姜，再炒一分钟。
steps.sourceDescription: Add the garlic and ginger and stir-fry for a minute.

steps.description: 拌入面条，然后加入酱汁混合物和腰果，混合均匀并彻底加热。
steps.sourceDescription: Stir through the noodles and then add the sauce mixture and cashews and mix until thoroughly combined and heated through.

steps.description: 给萝卜去皮并擦碎，再沥去擦碎萝卜中的多余水分。
steps.sourceDescription: Peal a radish and grate it. Then, drain excess liquid from the grated radish.

steps.description: 给姜去皮并擦碎。
steps.sourceDescription: Peal a ginger and grate it.

steps.description: 把葱切片。
steps.sourceDescription: Slice the green onion.

steps.description: 碾碎芝麻。
steps.sourceDescription: Crush sesame.

steps.description: 把面条煮 13 - 15 分钟，再用冷水冲洗。
steps.sourceDescription: Boil noodle for 13 - 15 minutes. Then, wash the noodle with cold water.

steps.description: 把面条放入碗中。
steps.sourceDescription: Put the noodle in a bowl.

steps.description: 在面条上放好擦碎的萝卜、葱和姜。
steps.sourceDescription: Arrange the grated radish, green onion, ginger on the noodle.

steps.description: 在上面撒上碾碎的芝麻。
steps.sourceDescription: Put the crushed sesame on the top.

steps.description: 把乌冬汤底倒入碗中。
steps.sourceDescription: Put the udon soup into the bowl.
